overlapping AFG, though title insurance is a major differing business."},{"label":"C12","good":true,"reason":"Underwrites specialty and excess and surplus commercial property lines sold through lines."},{"label":"C16","good":false,"reason":"An independent insurance agency earning commissions from carriers, not an underwriter carrying policy risk."},{"label":"C17","good":false,"reason":"An asset manager earning fees on funds and separate accounts, with no insurance underwriting."},{"label":"C18","good":true,"reason":"Underwrites specialty commercial liability, property and workers' compensation through independent agents and brokers, closely matching AFG."}]}
